original_question: Let K be a full subcategory of Top0 containing Sob. Is the product space of an arbitrary family of K-determined spaces itself K-determined?
target_in_paper: Section 5, Question 5.21: whether the product of an arbitrary family of K-determined spaces is again K-determined, where K is a full subcategory of Top0 containing Sob. ([repository.nie.edu.sg](https://repository.nie.edu.sg/server/api/core/bitstreams/05c40b88-abb7-4333-9d75-1683e771d05e/content))
correct_elements: Your draft already captures the exact official open problem at the space level: it has the right ambient hypothesis on K, the right arbitrary-product scope, and the right closure question for K-determined spaces. It also matches Question 5.21 rather than the nearby but different Question 5.20 about products of K-determined subsets. ([repository.nie.edu.sg](https://repository.nie.edu.sg/server/api/core/bitstreams/05c40b88-abb7-4333-9d75-1683e771d05e/content))
missing_details: The paper's term “K-determined” is defined first for subsets: a subset A of a T0 space X is K-determined if for every continuous map f:X→Y into a K-space Y, there exists a unique y_A in Y with f(A)={y_A}. That definition is needed for the question to be stand-alone. ([repository.nie.edu.sg](https://repository.nie.edu.sg/server/api/core/bitstreams/05c40b88-abb7-4333-9d75-1683e771d05e/content))

A T0 space X is K-determined precisely when every irreducible closed subset of X is K-determined; your draft uses this term without unpacking it. ([repository.nie.edu.sg](https://repository.nie.edu.sg/server/api/core/bitstreams/05c40b88-abb7-4333-9d75-1683e771d05e/content))

The factors are implicitly T0 spaces, since the ambient category is Top0 and the definition of K-determined spaces is stated only for T0 spaces. ([repository.nie.edu.sg](https://repository.nie.edu.sg/server/api/core/bitstreams/05c40b88-abb7-4333-9d75-1683e771d05e/content))

To be fully self-contained, the meaning of “irreducible closed” should be stated: a nonempty closed set A such that A⊆F1∪F2 with F1,F2 closed implies A⊆F1 or A⊆F2. ([repository.nie.edu.sg](https://repository.nie.edu.sg/server/api/core/bitstreams/05c40b88-abb7-4333-9d75-1683e771d05e/content))

The nearby context is that finite products are known for the special case of well-filtered determined spaces in Corollary 5.19, and Question 5.21 is the arbitrary-product version for general K-determined spaces. ([repository.nie.edu.sg](https://repository.nie.edu.sg/server/api/core/bitstreams/05c40b88-abb7-4333-9d75-1683e771d05e/content))

The paper notes parenthetically that the hypothesis on K includes, in particular, the case when K is a Keimel-Lawson category. ([repository.nie.edu.sg](https://repository.nie.edu.sg/server/api/core/bitstreams/05c40b88-abb7-4333-9d75-1683e771d05e/content))
refined_question: Let K be a full subcategory of Top0 containing Sob. For a T0 space X, call a subset A⊆X K-determined if for every continuous map f:X→Y into an object Y of K there exists a unique point y_A∈Y such that f(A)={y_A}; call X K-determined if every irreducible closed subset A of X (that is, every nonempty closed A such that A⊆F1∪F2 with F1,F2 closed implies A⊆F1 or A⊆F2) is K-determined. If {X_i : i∈I} is an arbitrary family of K-determined T0 spaces, must the product space ∏_{i∈I} X_i, equipped with the product topology, also be K-determined? ([repository.nie.edu.sg](https://repository.nie.edu.sg/server/api/core/bitstreams/05c40b88-abb7-4333-9d75-1683e771d05e/content))
justification: The draft is already very close to the paper's intended problem, but the exact target is the official Question 5.21 in Section 5, not a broader product-preservation problem. The essential sharpening is only to unpack the paper's Definition 5.5 of K-determined subsets/spaces and to keep the scope at arbitrary products of spaces. The neighboring Question 5.20 is a distinct set-level product question, while Corollary 5.19 gives only a finite-product result for well-filtered determined spaces; that nearby sequence of results makes clear that your draft is aiming specifically at Question 5.21. ([repository.nie.edu.sg](https://repository.nie.edu.sg/server/api/core/bitstreams/05c40b88-abb7-4333-9d75-1683e771d05e/content))
